title: My Favorite Portable Power Station Is at Its Lowest Price Ever
gist: The Bluetti Elite 300 portable power station (3,014 Wh, 2,400 W continuous) is $500 off at $1,000 for Prime Day, its lowest price ever; the reviewer notes power stations rarely sell at list price and that this unit packs more capacity than the ~2,000 Wh typical of its form factor.

themes.theme: Portable power station density and pricing

insights.claim: The Bluetti Elite 300 packs a 3,014 Wh battery into a form factor that usually holds around 2,000 Wh, roughly 50% more capacity per footprint.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Energy-density gains in consumer LFP-style storage are expanding the home-backup/RV market at lower $/Wh.
insights.quote: Bluetti has managed to pack more capacity than usual into a form factor that usually offers around 2,000 watt-hours

insights.claim: At $1,000 for 3,014 Wh, the deal works out to roughly $0.33 per watt-hour of portable storage, versus a list price of $1,499 and typical street price of $1,100–$1,200.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Consumer battery storage pricing is falling toward levels that make home backup mainstream.
insights.locator: While portable power stations often go on sale

insights.claim: Portable power stations spend very little time at their retail price, meaning list prices are largely notional in this category.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Persistent discounting suggests oversupply/competition among Chinese power-station brands and compressed margins.
insights.quote: While portable power stations often go on sale (in fact, they spend very little time at their retail price)
insights.locator: While portable power stations often go on sale

insights.claim: The Elite 300 delivers 2,400 W continuous/4,800 W surge, accepts up to 1,200 W solar input via XT60 (full charge in just over four hours ideally), and works as a UPS with a 10-millisecond switchover.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Power stations are converging with home UPS and solar-backup use cases, widening the addressable market beyond camping.
insights.quote: The Bluetti Elite 300 also works as an uninterruptible power supply with a 10-millisecond delay
